examDefinition: A Private Cloud consists of computing resources used exclusively by one business or organization, physically located at the company on-site datacenter or hosted by a third-party.
useCases: High-security defense or classified government workloads
Strict national data sovereignty requiring air-gapped hardware
Legacy workloads with non-virtualizable specialized mainframes
bestPractices: Evaluate Azure Stack Hub to run Azure-consistent cloud services on-premises
Connect private environments to Azure via ExpressRoute for hybrid bursting
Maintain dedicated physical security and hardware lifecycle governance
